[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 17:34  
[USER] User requested the generation of a use case.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed ability to generate use cases and requested more information on the type of use case and specific requirements.  
[USER] User specified the use case is for an LMS (Learning Management System).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a sample use case titled "Enrolling Students in Online Courses" with the following details:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Primary Actor: Administrator  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Goal: The administrator wants to enroll a group of students in an online course offered by the LMS.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Preconditions:  
- The administrator has access to the LMS platform  
- The course is available and has open enrollment  
- The administrator has a list of student names and email addresses  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trigger: The administrator wants to enroll a group of students in the course.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Description steps for the use case:  
1. The administrator logs into the LMS platform  
2. The administrator navigates to the "Courses" section of the LMS  
3. The administrator selects the course for which they want to enroll students  
4. The administrator clicks on the "Enroll Students" button  
5. The administrator uploads a CSV file containing the student names and email addresses  
6. The LMS processes the file and enrolls all of the students in the course  
7. The administrator receives a confirmation message indicating that the students have been successfully enrolled in the course.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Postconditions:  
- The students are enrolled in the course and have access to its content  
- The administrator can view the enrollment list for the course  
[USER] User requested additional functionalities for the LMS, including checking attendance, sending notifications, adding teachers, and generating a timetable.
